blocks.heading: Why Stay Near Ranthambore Road?
blocks.intro: All our partner resorts are situated within 5 to 15 minutes of the main park gates. This eliminates highway fatigue so you can wake up refreshed for your dawn safari.

items.title: Singhdwar Core Gate (10 Mins)
items.text: Shortest transfer times to Zones 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5.

items.title: Rajbagh Naka Gate (8 Mins)
items.text: Quick access to the dramatic Kundal cliff trails of Zone 6.

items.title: Station Transfer (15 Mins)
items.text: Effortless railway connectivity to Sawai Madhopur Junction.

items.title: Fresh Organic Produce
items.text: Vegetables and herbs sourced directly from resort organic gardens for flavorful farm-to-table dining.

items.title: Pre-Safari Dawn Breakfast
items.text: Freshly brewed coffee, hot tea, and cookies served before your Gypsy arrives at the lobby.

items.title: Jungle Bonfire Nights
items.text: Unwind by crackling outdoor fire pits with wildlife documentaries, live folk instruments, and fellow travelers.

items.q: Do you offer combined Resort + Safari permit packages?
items.a: Yes! Over 80% of guests book complete combos bundling resort stay, buffet meals, Gypsy permits, and station transfers in a single confirmed booking.

items.q: How far are the resorts from safari gates?
items.a: Most premier resorts are situated along Ranthambore Road, just 5 to 15 minutes drive from Singhdwar and Rajbagh entry gates.

items.q: Can special dietary meals be arranged?
items.a: Yes, partner resorts readily cater to Pure Vegetarian, Jain, Vegan, and Gluten-Free requirements with prior notice.
